root_cause: Portal V2 had a third-party AI Modelwijzer catalogue but no authenticated customer model preference page. Supplier VERIFY/PARTIAL/CONFLICT evidence was not visible to customers selecting a route; treating listing as activation would conflate documentation with real tenant entitlement.
prevention_rule: Every model is visible for research and shortlist only. Explicit per-model evidence status, EEA storage/inference and customer authorization must remain separate. A tenant preference is never an instruction to execute inference; no model is auto-approved by catalogue status. Regression tests verify this boundary.

test_evidence.expected: 110 unique catalogue IDs; 83 registered, 26 partial, 1 conflict; model selection tenant-scoped; no runtime activation; source-labeled sovereignty fields
test_evidence.result: Pending protected CI replay at time of authoring.

outcome.implementation: Draft PR #4380. Productieacceptatie nog niet uitgevoerd.

notes.basis: Supabase supplier status query on 2026-10-15 plus GitHub review; legal guidance EC and EDPB public sources; no customer DPA or authenticated runtime approval.
